subject: Throughput calibration & rollback window for AtlasWorks dedicated migration
messages:
From: Jordan Blake <jordan.blake@redwood.inference>
To: Alice Monroe <alice.monroe@atlasworks.com>
Cc: Marcus Lin <marcus.lin@redwood.inference>, Kimberly Park <kimberly.park@redwood.inference>
Date: 2026-08-02T09:12:00-07:00
Subject: Throughput calibration & rollback window for AtlasWorks dedicated migration

Hi Alice —

Following our kickoff, I wanted to pin down the throughput calibration and proposed rollback window for your hosted->dedicated migration. Key asks from our side to make the cutover low-risk: 

- One business-day rehearsal run (staging) with production traffic replay at 60/80/100% expected qps.
- A 4-hour primary cutover window with an immediate 2-hour rollback window if tail latency degradation > 2x or error rate > 1.5%.
- Final capacity matrix (attached) with headroom buckets for peak business hours and scheduled batch jobs.

Attached: capacity_matrix_v2.xlsx (contains recommended GPU pools, padding, and load profiles).

Can you confirm which two engineers will be on the cutover call and whether your procurement team needs a formal runbook excerpt to approve the schedule?

Thanks,
Jordan Blake
Senior Solutions Engineer | Redwood Inference
jordan.blake@redwood.inference | +1 (415) 555-0132
[attachment: capacity_matrix_v2.xlsx (xlsx, 42KB)]

From: Alice Monroe <alice.monroe@atlasworks.com>
To: Jordan Blake <jordan.blake@redwood.inference>
Cc: AtlasWorks Procurement <procurement@atlasworks.com>
Date: 2026-08-02T11:07:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Throughput calibration & rollback window for AtlasWorks dedicated migration

Jordan —

Thanks for the clear plan and matrix. Quick answers:
- Engineers on call: me (Alice) and Ravi Kumar (ravi.kumar@atlasworks.com).
- Procurement will want a short runbook excerpt showing the rollback trigger thresholds and the communication plan. Procurement copied here (procurement@atlasworks.com).

Couple of questions from our SRE: what telemetry will Redwood stream during rehearsal (token-level latency, per-node GPU utilization, KV cache hit rates)? Also can we shorten the rollback window to 90 minutes if we add a warm fallback to the hosted instance?

Appreciate it — we’d like to lock the rehearsal next Tuesday (2026-08-10).

—Alice
Platform Lead, AtlasWorks

From: Marcus Lin <marcus.lin@redwood.inference>
To: Jordan Blake <jordan.blake@redwood.inference>, Alice Monroe <alice.monroe@atlasworks.com>
Cc: Kimberly Park <kimberly.park@redwood.inference>
Date: 2026-08-02T13:21:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Throughput calibration & rollback window for AtlasWorks dedicated migration

On Mon, Aug 2, 2026 at 09:12 Jordan Blake wrote:
> Following our kickoff, I wanted to pin down the throughput calibration and proposed rollback window for your hosted->dedicated migration.

Hi all —

Summary answers to Alice's questions:
- Telemetry we will stream during rehearsal: token-level latency (p50/p95/p99), per-GPU utilization, queue length, KV cache hit rate, model variant fallback count, and top-10 error types. We'll push metrics to your Datadog project and provide a temporary read-only Grafana link.
- Shortening rollback: yes, we can agree to a 90-minute rollback window if AtlasWorks runs a warm-hosted fallback with routing priority set to return to hosted within 5 minutes. That requires a small prefailure test (we'll include steps).

I've also attached a short runbook snippet we can hand to procurement.

Attachment: runbook-snippet.md

Marcus Lin
Head of Dedicated Operations | Redwood Inference

From: Alice Monroe <alice.monroe@atlasworks.com>
To: Marcus Lin <marcus.lin@redwood.inference>, Jordan Blake <jordan.blake@redwood.inference>
Cc: AtlasWorks Procurement <procurement@atlasworks.com>
Date: 2026-08-03T08:15:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Throughput calibration & rollback window for AtlasWorks dedicated migration

Marcus/Jordan —

This looks good. Procurement reviewed the runbook excerpt and asked for two small edits: 1) explicit escalation path (phone numbers) and 2) a mention of the DocuSign approval for the reserved capacity amendment. Procurement is fine with the 90-minute rollback if the warm fallback is validated.

We'll target the rehearsal for Tue 2026-08-10 at 10:00 PT and the production cutover for Fri 2026-08-14 in the 04:00–08:00 PT window (your proposed 4-hour slot). Please confirm you have the team for those times.

—Alice

From: Jordan Blake <jordan.blake@redwood.inference>
To: Grace Oconnor <grace.oconnor@redwood.inference>
Cc: Marcus Lin <marcus.lin@redwood.inference>, Kimberly Park <kimberly.park@redwood.inference>, Alice Monroe <alice.monroe@atlasworks.com>
Date: 2026-08-04T10:03:00-07:00
Subject: Approval request: AtlasWorks rehearsal & tightened rollback window (deal AW-2026-183)

Grace —

Quick ask: AtlasWorks is comfortable shortening the rollback window to 90 minutes provided we validate a warm-hosted fallback during rehearsal. Rehearsal: Tue 2026-08-10 10:00 PT. Production cutover: Fri 2026-08-14 04:00–08:00 PT.

Risk/benefit: shorter rollback reduces customer downtime and their operational exposure; it increases pressure on our rollback automation and monitoring alerts. Marcus has confirmed the telemetry feed and the prefailure test steps in the attached runbook snippet.

Attachments: runbook-snippet.md

Can you sign off on the tightened rollback window and the cadence so we can finalize the DocuSign amendment?

Thanks,
Jordan

From: Grace Oconnor <grace.oconnor@redwood.inference>
To: Jordan Blake <jordan.blake@redwood.inference>
Cc: Marcus Lin <marcus.lin@redwood.inference>, Kimberly Park <kimberly.park@redwood.inference>, Alice Monroe <alice.monroe@atlasworks.com>, AtlasWorks Procurement <procurement@atlasworks.com>
Date: 2026-08-05T15:23:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Approval request: AtlasWorks rehearsal & tightened rollback window (deal AW-2026-183)

Jordan —

Sign-off granted with two conditions: 1) include the on-call phone numbers and escalation matrix in the runbook excerpt; 2) legal to insert a standard 5% reserved-capacity overage clause for the first 30 days post-cutover to handle unknown peak patterns (we'll bill/reconcile).

Marcus, please update the runbook snippet and send me the final DocuSign link once procurement confirms. Jordan/Alice — proceed to lock times.

Grace Oconnor
VP, Customer Ops | Redwood Inference
